reuse.why: Calls the existing assertBankAccountNotLinked, findOrCreateBank, bankSync.syncAccount and handleSyncResponse, but the link flow and the transaction download are new per-provider copies rather than shared code.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near line-for-line copy of linkPluggyAiAccount/linkAkahuAccount and downloadFintegraTransactions is a verbatim copy of downloadAkahuTransactions with only the server constant changed.

placement.why: Each piece goes where its provider siblings live: link handler in accounts/app.ts, download in accounts/sync.ts, base path in server-config.ts and the type in types/models.

scope.why: Only the files needed to add a server-side provider are touched, plus a release note.

maintainability.why: Consistent with the tree's existing per-provider copy pattern, so it is easy to follow, but it adds a sixth copy of the link flow and a second identical download function that future fixes must touch.
